setting: A valley between hills and the sea, with streams, woods and grassland, where three families live within a morning's walk of each other. Berries grow by the woods, fish swim in the streams, deer graze the meadows and a few wolves live in the woods. Seasons turn quickly; in winter nothing grows, nights are colder, and food that is not cooked or stored spoils. People live about seventy years here, but the years pass very fast.

bands.name: the river family
bands.history: We fish and hunt by the river and cook what we catch; the grove family and the stone family live nearby in the valley. There are two couples among us.

bands.name: the grove family
bands.history: We gather and plant berries by the woods and keep stores for winter; the river family and the stone family live nearby in the valley. There are two couples among us.

bands.name: the stone family
bands.history: We work wood and stone on the hillside and build well; the river family and the grove family live nearby in the valley. There are two couples among us.
